newsitem.title: CHINA: CKI signs water contracts in Shenyang.
newsitem.headline: CKI signs water contracts in Shenyang.

text.p: Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd (CKI) said on Wednesday it had signed two water plant contracts worth a total of 200 million yuan in Shenyang city in China's Liaoning province.

The contracts cover the Shenyang Shifosi water plant's phase one, now operational with a capacity of 200,000 tonnes per day, and phase two, due for completion in two years, which will boost total capacity to 400,000 tonnes, CKI said in a statement.
The plant represents total investment of 400 million yuan, of which CKI will be responsible for half. The joint venture period will last for 20 years, it said.
CKI said it has now invested 2.6 billion yuan in Liaoning in northern China in the span of one year.
It also has investments in Guangdong province in the south, and Henan and Hebei provinces in central China.
The company has investments in 712 km of roads and bridges and capacity of 770,000 tonnes of water per day in China, as well as 5,305 megawatts of power in Hong Kong and China.
